title: Pick free ports automatically and publish them
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. If 9090-9094 are taken, choose a free block, persist it and publish ~/.susi/ports.json so clients find susi; SUSI_PORT_OFFSET stays only as an override. Tests zc_port_autoselect_*.
